summary: Marex Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the consummation of a scheme of arrangement and redomiciliation: Marex Group plc became a wholly-owned subsidiary of a new Bermuda holding company, Marex Group Limited, effective July 1, 2026. Shareholders received one new ordinary share for each existing ordinary share. The old shares were delisted from Nasdaq on June 30, 2026, and the new shares began trading on Nasdaq on July 1, 2026 under the same symbol MRX. No premium, price per share, or financial terms were involved; this is a corporate restructuring via redomiciliation. The board approved the scheme, which was sanctioned by the High Court of England and Wales. What to watch: this changes the corporate jurisdiction but not shareholder economics.
